cases.verbatim_row: | K01 | s-a and exact-question independently approved attestation | READY; private bundle preserves all IDs, offsets, hashes, metadata and lifecycle |
| K02 | No attestation IDs | E/missing_applicability, no automatic proposal or approval |
| K03 | Task 3 proposal pending | E/stale_attestation |
| K04 | Ingestion approved; caller adds reviewed/reviewer fields | I/schema |
| K05 | Wrong/IR/SA/alias-of-AP tokens attempt applicability approval | Private PermissionError, record unchanged/pending; check E/stale_attestation |
| K06 | Forged source ID in held bundle submitted for proposal | E/binding_mismatch; no Task 3 record created |
| K07 | Forged chunk ID or wrong source/chunk pair in held bundle | E/binding_mismatch for both; no new authority |
| K08 | Tamper stored chunk text, hash or offset separately | E/integrity_failure; no partial result |
| K09 | Multi-chunk source; substitute document hash for Review chunk hash in an otherwise valid signed test proposal | E/binding_mismatch |
| K10 | Revoke Task 3 approval | E/stale_attestation |
| K11 | Supersede Task 3 approval with approved same-bundle successor | Old ID E/stale_attestation; current successor READY |
| K12 | Both clocks advance to day after expiry | E/stale_attestation |
| K13 | Source revoked/retired/superseded (three variants) | Fresh check E/no_evidence; held-bundle proposal E/stale_source |
| K14 | Repropose identical source bytes, approve/ingest again, use old Task 3 binding | E/binding_mismatch; document/chunk identities changed |
| K15 | Request jurisdiction Testland-B, separately admitted fixture | E/no_evidence, no fallback |
| K16 | Request edition E2, separately admitted fixture | E/no_evidence |
| K17 | Source correct but signed Review jurisdiction or edition differs | E/binding_mismatch, each variant |
| K18 | Q changes by one space, punctuation or case, admitted request but old approval | E/binding_mismatch; no normalized reuse |
| K19 | Change search query to `stair`, same selected evidence/full Q, admitted fixture | E/binding_mismatch; bundle reapproval required |
| K20 | s-inject valid source and separate approval | READY; literal text retained privately, no prints, commands, fetch or role change |
| K21 | s-a+s-b with both exact whole-bundle approvals | READY; both retained, aliases 1/2; conflict not resolved |
| K22 | s-a+s-b, only s-a approved/submitted | E/missing_applicability; no partial success |
| K23 | s-a+s-c; submit signed record bound to suppressed s-c | E/binding_mismatch |
| K24 | Swap aliases or submit another bundle's valid record | E/binding_mismatch |
| K25 | Unknown canonical Task 3 record ID | E/missing_applicability |
| K26 | Uppercase/truncated/duplicate IDs or unknown request fields | I/schema for each |
| K27 | Transplant equal-version signed Task 3 records under different registry keys | E/integrity_failure; existing substitution defense retained |
| K28 | Replay old signed approval after revocation, audit intact | E/integrity_failure |
| K29 | Legacy seal or changed embedded registry ID | E/integrity_failure, no migration/resigning |
| K30 | Wrong verifier credential | E/authorization_missing; no private serialization |
| K31 | Unauthorized private bundle/record inspection | Private PermissionError before serialization; no data/log leakage |
| K32 | Inject non-integrity exception containing sentinel during inspect/encoding | E/internal_failure; no raw exception, traceback, stdout or stderr |
| K33 | Fixture not authorized; separately, caller adds exercise=True | E/authorization_missing; I/schema respectively |
| K34 | General/company/mixed/unclear intent or recognized unsupported scope, admitted fixtures | E/unsupported_scope; no source-less education bypass |
| K35 | Exactly 16 distinct matching entries/approvals below byte cap, k=16 | READY, all 16 verified |
| K36 | 17 IDs and 20 IDs, including an invalid element in each | R/reference_limit before element validation; no truncation |
| K37 | 21 malformed references | Adapter R/reference_limit; standalone Task 4 still resource_limit at >20 |

| K38 | Each request/bundle/text byte, string-length, query-token or corpus cap exceeded by one, valid types | R/input_limit or R/corpus_limit respectively; no partial scan output; reference count/k/session caps tested separately |
| K39 | bool k, k=0/17, unknown scope, wrong types/container or lone surrogate | I/schema, no coercion |
| K40 | Empty corpus or no lexical match | E/no_evidence |
| K41 | Source withdrawal completes before check starts | E/no_evidence |
| K42 | Source/attestation withdrawal races with active check under coordinator lock | Writer waits; READY linearizes first; next check E/no_evidence or E/stale_attestation; no deadlock |
| K43 | Test hook changes source epoch or date between final checks | E/stale_snapshot or E/clock_changed respectively; no retry |

| K44 | Task 4.3 Unicode/CRLF location text, code metadata; admitted Q and search `thermal bridge` | Original slices/bytes and independent IDs/hashes retained; separately approved selected chunks yield READY |
| K45 | 100 repetitions, reverse insertion/attestation submission order, fixed records/date | Identical alias map, bundle ID, status/reason; bounded private inspect audit growth allowed |
| K46 | Fresh process, recreate source bundle but no Task 3 approvals; supply old IDs | E/missing_applicability; no import/cached readiness |

| K47 | Static false claim `All stairs are compliant [1].` with valid ID | Existing citations_valid may be True; no preflight claim/draft output; existing private-boundary false-claim regression still withholds prose |
| K48 | Static [99], [01], linked [1](...), Unicode brackets and declared/parsed mismatch | Existing citations_valid False for each with allowed={'1'}; no repair |
| K49 | Call original Task 4 task3_attestation_adapter | PermissionError unchanged, no activation switch |
| K50 | Tripwires on Gateway.respond/hold, OfflinePrototype.public/view, worker/network entry points during preflight | No calls; only inspect and pure eligible checks; no draft storage additions |
| K51 | Concurrent second check | R/busy; zero queued work |

| K52 | Exhaust 1,024-call, 100-source-proposal or 256-attestation-record session cap separately, then attempt another operation | R/input_limit before underlying operation; no eviction/automatic reset; test-owned counters may isolate otherwise unreachable cap combinations |
